app.title: NetWorth Visualizer
app.tagline: Local only · data stays in this browser

dnd.investmentInsufficientPool: Not enough savings pool at that month to fund this investment (lump sum + monthly contribution). Drag farther right or add income first.
dnd.assetInsufficientReserve: Not enough reserve at that month to cover the asset down payment. Drag farther right or increase reserve first.

emptyState.headline: Map your financial future
emptyState.body: Pick a category in the strip below, then add events.

carousel.deleteDropActive: Drop here to remove the event from your plan
carousel.deleteDropZoneSubtitle: Release here to remove it from your plan

form.empty: Pick an event type in the strip below. When a draft appears, edit it under <0>Event editor</0>, then drag the round icon on the line between Timeline and editor onto the chart to place it.
form.name: Name

horizon.delta: {{arrow}} {{delta}} vs current plan at horizon · {{total}} total

career.hintGross: Gross salary per month before tax. Example: 8000 for $8k/mo.
career.hintSavings: Drag the monthly dollar cap to the pool; the % of net income updates to match.
career.hintTax: Drag monthly tax withheld; effective % of gross updates to match.

asset.hintApr: Annual rate as a decimal: 0.045 means 4.5% per year.
asset.sacPaymentHint: SAC starts higher and decreases over time.
asset.reserveShortfallAtMonth: Reserve shortfall at M{{month}}: {{amount}} needed for down payment.
asset.hintValueChange: Expected annual appreciation of the asset as decimal (0.03 = 3%).

investment.month0Pool: Month 0: the pool is filled from career surplus in the same month before contributions run.
investment.pullTail: from the pool (never more than the balance).
investment.shortfall: Plan shortfall month {{m}}: {{amount}} — scheduled contributions exceeded the pool (all investments combined).
investment.initialFromPoolHint: Pulled from the savings pool on the start month (same order as the simulation).
investment.lumpSumInitialHint: Default and max follow the same order as the simulation: earlier investments’ one-time pulls, then their scheduled monthly pulls, then this lump — so the amount never exceeds what the pool can actually fund after those commitments.
investment.referenceDrag: Reference month: where you are placing on the chart (drag).
investment.referenceStart: Reference month: event start M{{month}} (pin a month on the chart to preview elsewhere).
investment.monthlyPoolCapHint: Slider track = pool deposit (income). Recurring is capped by the lower of (a) cash available in the pool before this row’s pull and (b) your remaining share of this month’s deposit after earlier investments’ scheduled amounts—so 50% + 50% of income cannot be exceeded even with a large savings balance. The amber line is total income to pool net of all funding (informational).
investment.monthlyPoolDepositContext: Monthly income routed to the savings pool this month: {{amount}}.
investment.noPoolDeposit: No pool deposit at this reference month — add income or pin another month on the chart. You can still type an amount (may show shortfall).
investment.manualMonthlyHint: Enter any amount; the plan may show a pool shortfall until income catches up.
investment.pctOfPoolNetAfterFundingSuffix: of income to pool (net of funding)
investment.pctOfRemainingPoolSuffix: of remaining pool before this investment
investment.hintReturn: Nominal annual return as decimal, e.g. 0.07 for 7%.

life.hintExpense: Change to monthly spending (negative reduces expenses).
life.hintIncome: Drag resulting monthly gross; % of first career income updates. 100% = no cut.
life.addCareerHint: Add a career event to set $/mo

windfall.hint: One-time credit to the savings pool on the start month (inheritance, gift, settlement). Does not pass through investments unless you fund them from the pool later.

macro.hintInflation: Drag extra yearly spend from inflation on a $12k/yr example; % updates.
macro.hintMarket: Drag yearly return add-on on a portfolio notional; % modifier updates.
macro.hintPoolYield: Drag yearly interest on a $10k reference pool; annual % updates. Engine uses this when macro is active.

graph.investmentStackClickHint: Click the investments band to toggle Breakdown (same as Settings), or turn it on in Settings. With Breakdown on, hover a ribbon to see that investment’s balance in the tooltip. Other bands highlight on hover.
graph.markerAria: {{name}}. Click to edit. Drag horizontally on the chart to change the start month.
graph.markerAriaDelete: {{name}}. Click to edit. Drag horizontally on the chart to change the start month. Middle-click to delete.
graph.pinnedBadgeTitle: Pinned — click the chart again to unpin.
graph.monthlyChangeBreakdown: Change vs prior month — by source
graph.monthlyChangeBreakdownHint: Each line is that source’s share of this month’s net-worth change.
graph.lifeRulerToggleTooltip: Click to show or hide the life timeline
graph.shortfallBadgeTitle: Investment underfunded 3+ months in a row
graph.xBrushBandTitle: Drag horizontally to zoom the time range

draggable.title: Drag onto the chart to place on the timeline (sets start month)
draggable.ariaLabel: Drag onto chart to add or move this event on the timeline
draggable.titlePinned: Click to place at the pinned month, or drag onto the chart
draggable.ariaLabelPinned: Click to place at pinned month on chart, or drag onto chart to set start month
draggable.hint: Grab the handle — drop on the glowing chart area.
